title: [Expense Agent] Fix Employee subscriber permissions
summary: Fixes Expense Agent Employee event subscribers so they can sync and delete Expense Users without callers needing Expense User permissions, using method-scoped inherent permissions. Adds an API.ReadWrite.All application entitlement and moves internal agent APIs out of the Expense Management - Objects permission set.
key_points: New entitlement 'EA - Azure AD Application API' grants Expense Agent application API.ReadWrite.All access mapped to 'Expense Mgmt. Edit'
Employee event subscribers now have method-scoped inherent permissions for synchronization and deletion logic
Internal APIs (Expense Capabilities, Expense Projects, and Expense Project Tasks Query) moved to agent-only 'Expense Agent - Objects' permission set
Existing customer and partner Employee permission sets unaffected by changes
Comprehensive test suite added covering synchronization, deletion guards, and multiple permission profiles
